The monitoring bodies named in the executive order are themselves part of Putin’s vertical, so the main limitation is not absence of implementation but absence of independent constraint.","evidence":[{"title":"Executive Order on Russia’s development goals through 2030 and for the future until 2036","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-05-07","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/73986","summary":"Sets a formal national plan and tells the government to submit a unified plan, develop a spatial-development strategy, prepare an infrastructure plan through 2036, and ensure priority annual budget allocations. The Presidential Executive Office and State Council are assigned monitoring duties.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"List of instructions following Presidential Address to the Federal Assembly","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-03-30","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/assignments/orders/73759","summary":"Converts the address into measurable targets with deadlines: top-four GDP by PPP by 2030, poverty below 7%, 2% of GDP for R&D, higher manufacturing value added, lower import dependence, more domestic high-tech output, and infrastructure repairs.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Government will send additional financing to support medical workers in rural areas","publisher":"Government of Russia","date":"2024-12-18","url":"https://government.ru/docs/53769/","summary":"Extends `Zemsky Doctor` and `Zemsky Paramedic` through 2030, raises compensation, allows one intra-regional transfer, and says roughly 2,000 specialists were brought in during 2024. This is concrete staffing policy with funding and a time horizon.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Annual family payment law for citizens with two or more children","publisher":"Government of Russia","date":"2024-07-13","url":"https://government.ru/docs/all/154255/","summary":"Creates a nationwide annual family benefit for households with at least two children. This is a specific distributional instrument, not just rhetoric about family policy.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Putin taps civilian economist to run defence","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-05-13","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-taps-civilian-economist-to-run-defence/2081878/","summary":"Replaces Shoigu with Andrei Belousov to improve defence spending efficiency and innovation. That shows program-to-personnel translation in a major portfolio, though still inside a loyalist system.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.5"]},{"title":"Putin appoints Patrushev and Dyumin as Kremlin aides","publisher":"Reuters via ThePrint","date":"2024-05-14","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-appoints-patrushev-and-dyumin-as-kremlin-aides/2084276/","summary":"Moves long-time security insiders closer to the centre and keeps the core Kremlin circle intact. This is a concrete institutional staffing move, but it reinforces loyalty control more than autonomous governance.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.5"]},{"title":"Executive Order approving the Basic Principles of State Policy of the Russian Federation on Nuclear Deterrence","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-11-19","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/75598","summary":"Formalizes nuclear-use conditions and the threat set to be deterred. That turns strategic aims into an explicit doctrine and command framework.","question_ids":["8B.2","8B.1"]},{"title":"Putin signed law requiring social-media owners to provide user information to Roskomnadzor or the FSB","publisher":"President of Russia","date":"2024-08-08","url":"https://en.special.kremlin.ru/acts/news/74828","summary":"Builds an enforcement mechanism for information control by requiring user data disclosure and registration of large accounts. This is concrete institutionalization of regime control, not just messaging.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.7","7B.10"]},{"title":"Russian economy shows solid growth despite Ukraine war sanctions","publisher":"Reuters via Investing.com","date":"2024-08-28","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/economy-news/russian-economy-shows-solid-growth-despite-ukraine-war-sanctions-3591756","summary":"The reported growth and record-low unemployment were driven heavily by military production, showing that the 2024 program was implemented through wartime industrial mobilization rather than broad civilian development.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Putin lets economically significant entities limit information disclosures","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-01-29","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/putin-lets-economically-significant-entities-limit-information-disclosures-3315001","summary":"Weakens transparency and outside scrutiny for major firms, reducing the openness needed for independent correction or evaluation of the program.","question_ids":["8B.2","7B.7","7B.10"]},{"title":"Russia: Freedom in the World 2024","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2024","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2024","summary":"Describes power concentrated in Putin’s hands, weak transparency, and day-to-day decisions made by a small closed circle. That suggests the program is enforced from above, not through accountable institutions.","question_ids":["8B.2"]},{"title":"Russia’s 2024 budget spending factbox","publisher":"Reuters via Kelo / Reuters","date":"2024-03-11","url":"https://kelo.com/2024/03/11/factbox-putin-pledges-over-126-billion-in-public-spending-as-election-looms/","summary":"Reuters reported more than 11.5 trillion roubles in promised six-year infrastructure/social spending, but also that military spending would exceed social spending in 2024. This shows real budget translation, but one skewed toward war priorities.","question_ids":["8B.2"]}]}
